//: Real secrets go in appsettings.Local.json (git-ignored). This file is the template.
//allowedUserIds: Empty = anyone who finds the bot can use it. Add Telegram numeric ids to lock it down. Send /whoami to the bot to see an id.
//remindHour: Default daily nudge hour, local time. She can change it in the bot.
//dataPath: Optional. Where progress is stored. Default: %LOCALAPPDATA%\EnglishBot on Windows, ~/.local/share/EnglishBot on Linux. Never put this inside bin/ or publish/ - a rebuild would erase her streak.
//speech: Audio is FREE by default: Windows' own voice writes a WAV and VLC converts it to MP3. Nothing to sign up for. Needs Windows + VLC installed.
//speechRate: -10..10. Negative is slower. -2 is about right for a beginner imitating the sound.
//vlcPath: Only if VLC is somewhere unusual. Default looks in both Program Files folders.
//azureSpeechKey: Optional upgrade. Nicer neural voices, but needs an Azure account. Leave empty to use the free Windows voice above.
